newsitem.title: ITALY: L'Espresso details Repubblica share swap rate.
newsitem.headline: L'Espresso details Repubblica share swap rate.

text.p: The share swap rate for the merger between Italy's L'Espresso ESP.MI and its subsidiary La Repubblica will be 47 L'Espresso shares for every 100 Repubblica ones, a statement from the editorial group said.
The operation also aimed at "an increase of the outstanding stock of Editorial L'Espresso through a capital increase to service the share swap," the statement from L'Espresso said.
Both weekly news magazine L'Espresso and daily newspaper La Repubblica are controlled by Italian financier Carlo De Benedetti's industrial holding CIR.
The operations of La Repubblica and another publishing operation Editrice Periodici Culturali will included in the balance sheet of L'Espresso from December 31, 1997.
After the merger, based on current shareholdings, CIR will hold 52.5 percent of L'Espresso, 15.4 percent will be in the hands of other shareholders and 32.1 percent will be on the open market.

The statement said the merger had been decided in order to rationalise organisation and share structure and to create a single operation listed on the stock market which could finance expansion and strengthen investment.
